referee_caveats_inferred: The approximately 80-pc limit is directional; it should not be treated as isotropic source-plane resolution.
Residual fidelity is not an injection-and-recovery completeness measurement for clumps of different sizes and locations.
Independent image fits sample some lens-model systematics but do not establish full mass-model uncertainty propagation.
The luminosity and SFR limits assume a clump SED and conversion that may differ from the global galaxy values.
The stated sensitivity selection is ≤50 μJy beam−1, while the included single-continuum dataset has 60 μJy beam−1.
